label: Guider

manifest.name: Built-in Guider
manifest.description: Autoguider that runs inside astrolol, without PHD2: it picks guide stars, calibrates itself, and corrects the mount from any camera. Don't enable it together with PHD2.

title: Built-in Guider
intro: Keeps a star on the same spot while you image. Choose the guide camera, then start guiding: the first run calibrates by moving the mount a little.

settings.invalidPixelScale: The pixel scale must be a number of arcseconds per pixel above zero, or empty.
settings.pixelScaleOptics: Calculated from the telescope and the camera.
settings.mountHint: Lets the calibration follow slews and meridian flips.
settings.gainHint: Empty: leave the camera's gain as it is.
settings.starsHint: More stars average the seeing out.
settings.lostTimeoutHint: How long to look for a lost star. 0: until it comes back.

calibration.none: Not calibrated yet. The next run calibrates first.
calibration.noTrace: No measurements were kept for this calibration.
calibration.adjusted: Adjusted to where the mount points now.
calibration.distanceHint: How far calibration moves the star in each direction.

issues.noisy: The measurements scatter a lot: steadier air, a longer exposure or a brighter star would help.
issues.short_travel: The star moved only a short distance: increase the calibration distance.
issues.not_perpendicular: RA and Dec are not at right angles: check for backlash or a loose mount.
issues.ra_asymmetric: West and East moved the star at different speeds.
issues.dec_asymmetric: North and South moved the star at different speeds: Dec backlash or a stuck axis.
issues.rate_ratio: The RA speed does not match the declination: check the mount's guide rates.
issues.high_dec: Calibrated close to the pole: RA cannot be measured well there. Calibrate again nearer the celestial equator.
issues.dec_backlash_large: Dec backlash took up most of the way back.
issues.ra_backlash_large: RA backlash took up most of the way back.

darks.hint: Cover the telescope, then take darks with the exposure and gain above. They remove hot pixels from the guide star's surroundings.
darks.matches: A dark matches the current exposure and gain.
darks.noMatch: No dark for the current exposure and gain.

view.title: Guide camera
view.none: No image yet. Show the camera to see what it sees, or start guiding.
view.pickHint: Click a star to guide on it.
view.picked: This star will be the guide star.

tuning.aggressivenessHint: Share of the error corrected at each frame.
tuning.hysteresisHint: Share of the previous correction kept, to smooth the corrections out.
tuning.minMoveHint: Smaller errors are left alone: they are seeing, not drift.
tuning.decModeHint: Correcting one way only avoids Dec backlash on a mount that drifts one way.
tuning.resistHint: Changes direction only when several frames in a row, or one large error, ask for it.
tuning.backlashHint: Lengthens the first Dec correction after a change of direction by the backlash measured at calibration.
tuning.flipDecHint: Whether North pulses move the star the other way after a meridian flip. Guiding notices a wrong choice and corrects it.
tuning.predictDriftHint: Learns how the mount drifts and corrects it ahead.
tuning.predictPeHint: Learns the regular wobble of the RA gears and corrects it ahead.
tuning.wormPeriodHint: The time of one turn of the RA worm, if you know it.
